scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SHARED,API,WEB" -c "magenta.bold,yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/api && npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bookleaf/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@bookleaf/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bookleaf/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@bookleaf/web
